GA4_SA_KEY_PATH.description: Absolute path to the GA4 service-account JSON key file (gitignored — NEVER commit the key; e.g. local/<fleet>/.secrets/ga4-service-account.json)

GA4_PROPERTY_ID.description: Numeric GA4 property ID of the STORE property (bare number, e.g. 123456789 — NOT the G-XXXXXXXXXX measurement ID). Confirm it is the property whose data stream carries the store's measurement ID, not a same-named junk property.
